journal_rules: Every AI-Lover research change, run, literature pass, score change, falsification, failed hypothesis and safety decision must receive a new event_id.
Existing event records are immutable in meaning; corrections are appended as new correction events referencing the prior event_id.
Every event records evidence_state, claim_ceiling, affected artifacts and next gate.
Synthetic results must never be silently promoted to direct data.
Safety exclusions are results and must be logged, not omitted.
